purpose: Prevent corrected replay, rare-program qualification, multimodal support, survivor status or regulatory evidence from silently promoting a target, representation or training decision.

ordered_authority_ladder.name: CORRECTED_REPLAY_AUDIT_RESULT
grants: scientific interpretation of corrected TD56/TD57B/TD57C/TD59 only

ordered_authority_ladder.name: CANDIDATE_GATE_UPDATE
grants: update C2/C4 relational activity state; preserve C1/C3 independence and C6 dependency rules

ordered_authority_ladder.name: FOUNDATION_CANDIDATE_QUALIFICATION
grants: candidate-specific eligibility after existing gates, rare-program fitness, shortcut/coverage/uncertainty checks
does_not_grant: selection merely because one candidate remains

ordered_authority_ladder.name: SURVIVOR_ADJUDICATION
grants: eligible survivor set and next protected comparison

ordered_authority_ladder.name: PROTECTED_CONFIRMATION
grants: evidence for/against frozen survivor(s) on the specifically authorized protected confirmation surface

ordered_authority_ladder.name: EXPLICIT_TARGET_DECISION
grants: foundation target winner only when a separate authority record explicitly names it

ordered_authority_ladder.name: POST_FREEZE_MULTIMODAL_R1_R2_SUPPORT
grants: transport/regulatory interpretation of the already frozen target
classification of RNA-recoverable versus teacher-private privileged state

ordered_authority_ladder.name: EXPLICIT_REPRESENTATION_DECISION
grants: representation choice only after its own protected comparison/authority

ordered_authority_ladder.name: TD60_OR_SUCCESSOR
grants: only the specifically authorized downstream target/representation experiment

ordered_authority_ladder.name: STAGE4_AUTHORITY
grants: only the specifically authorized Stage4 scope
does_not_grant: unbounded real training or protected outcome opening beyond scope

ordered_authority_ladder.name: REAL_TRAINING_AUTHORITY
grants: real training only under exact frozen target, representation, data, split, runtime and stopping contract

TD57B_FAIL.note: TD59 cannot rescue an upstream TD57B failure.

TD57C_PASS.note: Corrected PASS is historical/corrected divergence, never retroactive validation of the old locality claim.

TD57C_FAIL__TD59_FAIL.note: Broader relational recurrence may still exist, but current structured locality support is insufficient.

ANY_NOT_ESTIMABLE.rule: Stop interpretation of that object; NOT_ESTIMABLE supplies no support and is never averaged into PASS.

source_qualification_boundary.universal_qualification: Whether every required observed source satisfied its frozen per-source criterion.
source_qualification_boundary.source_heterogeneity: Whether there is direct evidence that underlying source effects differ.
source_qualification_boundary.rule: PASS/FAIL threshold-status discordance may show universal qualification was not established but does not by itself prove biological heterogeneity.
source_qualification_boundary.source_order: Historical source execution order may be preserved for replay fidelity but is not a biological hierarchy.

rare_program_gate.rule: Rare-program fitness is a mandatory target-quality property but cannot rescue failure of a pre-existing candidate gate.
rare_program_gate.not_estimable: Retain candidate rare-program fitness as unresolved; do not convert missing stable rare evidence to PASS.

multimodal_boundary.foundation_selection: Multimodal outcomes may not retrospectively choose the foundation target once designated post-freeze support.
multimodal_boundary.same_nucleus: Supports within-nucleus regulatory correspondence and teacher-state decomposition after freeze.
multimodal_boundary.SCENIC_plus_and_regulatory: Supports R2 interpretation, privileged teacher construction and C5 specialist work; does not become a universal foundation answer key.
multimodal_boundary.spatial: Localization only when frozen program components are measured.
multimodal_boundary.perturbation: R3 direction support only under separate per-screen qualification.

automatic_promotion_prohibitions: Stage74 in-silico perturbation agreement -> causal validation
technical runtime qualification -> scientific training authority
non_authority_statement: No authority is granted by this file. It freezes the transition law that future explicit authorities must respect.
